JPY.catalyst: The Japanese yen leads the G10 complex over the rolling week with a +0.66% composite return, supported by rising expectations for additional Bank of Japan monetary tightening. Released minutes from the BOJ July meeting revealed the hawkish policy shift that paved the way for September's rate hike, with Tokyo Tanshi data showing a 97% probability that Governor Kazuo Ueda and the policy board will raise the key rate by 25 basis points to 1.25%. Domestic fundamental pressure is building after Japan's August services producer price index accelerated to 3.7% year-on-year, marking its fastest pace of expansion in over two years. Meanwhile, market participants remain alert to potential physical intervention by Japanese authorities following recent rate checks by officials in foreign exchange markets.

Investors are awaiting upcoming domestic CPI figures to confirm whether the RBA will push the cash rate higher at its upcoming monetary policy meeting.
